item.title: Odisha CM launches 109 development projects worth Rs 600 crore for Rayagada
item.description: Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Monday unveiled 109 development projects worth over Rs 600 crore for Rayagada district, giving a major boost to infrastructure, social welfare and economic growth in the region. item.title: 1 crore ganja hidden under cabbage load seized in Mayurbhanj; 5 held
item.description: In a major anti-narcotics operation, the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) has seized 23 sacks of ganja that were being smuggled by concealing the contraband beneath loads of cabbage in Mayurbhanj district of Odisha. Acting on specific intelligence, an NCB special squad tracked a pickup van carrying vegetables, which was allegedly transporting cannabis hidden under cabbage crates to evade detection during peak vegetable movement hours. item.description: The mutilated body of a 10-year-old Class V student, who had gone missing a day earlier, was recovered from an abandoned well in Belapada village under Gania police station limits in Nayagarh district on Wednesday morning, triggering widespread outrage in the area. item.title: Gold, silver prices rally again as global uncertainty fuels market volatility
item.description: Gold and silver prices witnessed a sharp rebound in the domestic market, reversing the recent downward trend amid growing global and macroeconomic uncertainties. After a brief phase of correction, both precious metals resumed their upward momentum. On the previous day, 22-carat gold had climbed by nearly Rs 1,000 to trade at around Rs 1,41,000 per 10 grams, while 24-carat gold was priced at approximately Rs 1,54,000.
